julies_letter.name: Julie's Letter
julies_letter.description: "I have drawn you a map. It was right when I drew it." A hundred-year-old envelope with this year's stamp. Use to read.

birthday_present.name: A Small Present
birthday_present.description: Packed in the backpack with the clothes. For an aunt you have never met. It is still for her.

apple.name: Apple
apple.description: Eat it for a quarter of your health back.

grape.name: Grape
grape.description: A tenth of your health back. They come by the bunch.

potion_manashield.name: Small Manashield Potion
potion_manashield.description: For 20 seconds, damage is paid from mana before health.

potion_lifesteal.name: Small Life Steal Potion
potion_lifesteal.description: For 20 seconds, 30% of the damage you deal comes back as health.

potion_critical.name: Small Critical Potion
potion_critical.description: For 20 seconds, one hit in three is critical.

potion_stoneskin.name: Small Stone Skin Potion
potion_stoneskin.description: For 20 seconds, physical damage is halved.

potion_sparktongue.name: Small Sparktongue Potion
potion_sparktongue.description: For 30 seconds, every hit you take gives back mana.

potion_stranglethorn.name: Small Stranglethorn Potion
potion_stranglethorn.description: For 30 seconds, your melee poisons. Rats will still eat meat soaked in it. So will snakes.

key_auntie_house.name: House Key
key_auntie_house.description: Opens Julie's front door. It is a little wet from the dog.

key_generic.name: Key
key_generic.description: Opens any plain lock once, then it is the lock's.

key_basement.name: Auntie's Basement Key
key_basement.description: One iron key. Julie's cellar has two iron doors that both take it.

key_pit.name: Pit Key
key_pit.description: Stamped GOLDSKIN on the bow. It opens the Company's padlocks down the mine, once each, and nothing else.

key_mine_headmaster.name: Headmaster's Key
key_mine_headmaster.description: The tag says HM, and under it, crossed out, PAY OFFICE. It was on a dead clerk.

key_mine_vault.name: Mine Vault Key
key_mine_vault.description: Heavy, off the Headmaster's own ring. It opens the vault.

key_mine_boss.name: Large Mine Key
key_mine_boss.description: Stamped GNOX GOLDSKIN. Opens the door everyone in the mine stopped opening.

key_snake.name: Snake Key
key_snake.description: Scales cast into the bow. It fits the door with scales on it.

key_snake_boss.name: Giant Snake Key
key_snake_boss.description: It takes both hands to turn. The giant door is the only lock it fits.

key_museum.name: Museum Key
key_museum.description: Brass, tagged SCIENCE / HISTORY / ART / MAGIC. The museum is not on this side of the county yet.

wood.name: Wood
wood.description: Repair eats it. Two planks mend a stair.

iron.name: Iron
iron.description: Repair eats it. Four bars mend a length of track.

rat_meat.name: Rat Meat
rat_meat.description: Not for eating. Soaked in Stranglethorn, it is bait.

poisoned_rat_meat.name: Poisoned Rat Meat
poisoned_rat_meat.description: Throw it down in front of you. A burial snake that smells it will come, and will not leave.

gold_bar.name: Gold Bar
gold_bar.description: Grinds into four measures of dust at a bench.

gold_dust.name: Gold Dust
gold_dust.description: Manashield, Life Steal and Critical all take a measure.

coal.name: Coal
coal.description: A lump of coal. Nothing Julie wrote down asks for it.

rock.name: Rock
rock.description: Breaks down into stone at a bench.

fire_stone.name: Fire Stone
fire_stone.description: Warm to hold. It will light a laid fire.

deadwood.name: Deadwood
deadwood.description: Dry sticks off a stump or a pile. Two lay a fire; another keeps it going.

match.name: Match
match.description: One strike, one fire. Not in the rain.

light_stone.name: Light Stone
light_stone.description: Throws a circle of light with no heat in it. Nothing will grow under it.

night_view_glass.name: Night View Glass
night_view_glass.description: A lens in a brass ring, marked NIGHT. Through it the dark looks the same.

small_water.name: Small Vial of Water
small_water.description: Every potion Julie wrote down starts with one.

small_empty_vial.name: Small Empty Vial
small_empty_vial.description: Dr Vane will fill it at his tap.

hemshade_root.name: Hemshade Root
hemshade_root.description: At the bench, with water: Firelash.

white_water_cap.name: White Water Cap
white_water_cap.description: At the bench, with water: Sparktongue.

night_lich_moss.name: Night Lich Moss
night_lich_moss.description: At the bench, with water: Winterbite.

savage_snakeroot.name: Savage Snakeroot
savage_snakeroot.description: At the bench, with water: Stranglethorn. The undead flowers carry it.

honeylace_lily.name: Honeylace Lily
honeylace_lily.description: At the bench, with gold dust and water: Critical.

nasturtium.name: Nasturtium
nasturtium.description: At the bench, with gold dust and water: Life Steal.

pansy.name: Pansy
pansy.description: At the bench, with gold dust and water: Manashield.

white_water_rose.name: White Water Rose
white_water_rose.description: At the bench, with stone and water: Stone Skin. Julie grew them in the cellar.
